title: All raised their thighs and eyed with disfavour the mildewed buttonless leather of the seats
html_source: Mr Dedalus and Cunningham may suspect that someone had more than just a picnic in the carriage. Perhaps that a couple might have used it as a private place for a tryst. If so, Simon Dedalus' “resignedly” admitting that “it’s the most natural thing in the world” is (to me), pretty funny.
